page.title: The mossy stand
page.description: The mossy stand. Recorded at about 105 m in the Glenabo catchment, Fermoy, Co. Cork.

hero.title: The mossy stand.
hero.alt: Moss-covered branches of broadleaf trees coming into leaf, light reaching the woodland floor

blocks.text:
One hundred and twenty-four metres from Stop 02, and a few metres lower. The difference is not the hill. It is what was planted, and when.

Moss runs along every limb, there is structure at three different heights, and light reaches the ground.

blocks.heading: The name of this glen
blocks.text: An account written down at Adair school in the 1930s explains how Glenabo got its name. It names the glen, not this particular spot.
